original_prompt:
Review this repo and plan a migration to run entirely in Deno. Make tasks in the "Container Claw"

section of vibe-kanban for the final plan.When working on tasks, prefer oh-my-claudecode orchestration modes:
- For complex multi-step tasks: use /oh-my-claudecode:team or /oh-my-claudecode:autopilot
- For planning: use /oh-my-claudecode:plan instead of basic planning
- For code review: use /oh-my-claudecode:code-review
- For build errors: use /oh-my-claudecode:build-fix
- For thorough search: use /oh-my-claudecode:deepsearch
- For git operations: use /oh-my-claudecode:git-master
- For UI/UX work: use /oh-my-claudecode:frontend-ui-ux
- For TDD: use /oh-my-claudecode:tdd
- For security audits: use /oh-my-claudecode:security-review

Use the oh-my-claudecode specialized agents (e.g., oh-my-claudecode:architect, oh-my-claudecode:executor, oh-my-claudecode:verifier) when spawning subagents via the Task tool, rather than generic agent types.
